verdicts.reason: A: logo, headline and body keep a clear hierarchy, and the URL is promoted to a legible, larger line. Flaws: the legal/event-details text is tiny and pushed far from the URL at the bottom, which breaks the original reading order (details before link). It also leaves a dead gap in the lower third. B: the URL and the event-details copy are both very small and nearly illegible at 300x600. The CTA link is buried and the whole text block is cramped. The tiny type is the key failure, though the grouping and order are intact.
